findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_studio_info, get_scan_packages_and_pricing, get_gestational_guide, check_booking_availability, lookup_booking_status, reschedule_booking, cancel_booking, get_studio_faqs_and_policies · Private data: get_studio_info, get_scan_packages_and_pricing, get_gestational_guide, check_booking_availability, create_booking, lookup_booking_status, reschedule_booking, cancel_booking, get_studio_faqs_and_policies · Public sink: get_studio_info, create_booking, reschedule_booking · Destructive: get_studio_info, get_scan_packages_and_pricing, get_gestational_guide, check_booking_availability, create_booking, lookup_booking_status, reschedule_booking, cancel_booking, get_studio_faqs_and_policies.
